inputs.text: The tribunals for voters removed from West Bengal’s electoral rolls are still not operational, with details of how they will work yet to be finalized. The state government and Calcutta High Court are discussing locations, while the software for voters to challenge rulings is ready. More than 58 lakh names were deleted during the revision exercise.
